input: Set up a memory box for the kids

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Memory Box for the Kids
gold.taskDescription: Create a dedicated memory box to collect and preserve meaningful items and mementos for the children.

questions.title: How many children is this memory box for?
questions.description: Determine whether there will be one shared box for all children or a separate box per child.

questions.title: What age are the children right now?
questions.description: Understand the ages of the children to tailor the box size, contents, and organization appropriately.

questions.title: What types of items do you want to store?
questions.description: Identify the kinds of mementos to include, such as drawings, photos, report cards, baby items, or certificates.

questions.title: Do you already have a box or container in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a physical container chosen or needs guidance on selecting one.

questions.title: How far back in time should the box start?
questions.description: Clarify whether the box begins from birth, a specific year, or from today going forward.

questions.title: Where will the memory box be stored at home?
questions.description: Establish the storage location to guide decisions about box size, durability, and labeling.

questions.title: Is this box meant to be given to the kids one day?
questions.description: Determine the long-term purpose — a keepsake to hand over at a milestone age, or an ongoing family archive.
